activity.notes: Władysław II Jagiełło, formerly the Lithuanian grand duke Jogaila, was crowned king of Poland in 1386 and reigned until 1434. This Activity records his Polish kingship; his Lithuanian grand-ducal career is a separate political role and is not merged into this Polish Activity.

sources.title: About the Museum — Wawel Royal Castle
sources.citation_text: Wawel Royal Castle states that Grand Duke Jogaila of Lithuania converted, married Jadwiga, and was crowned Ladislaus II Jagiello, with a reign dated 1386-1434.

sources.title: Royal History — Jagiellonian Chronicle educational material, Wawel Royal Castle
sources.citation_text: Wawel educational material gives Władysław Jagiełło's years of rule as 1386-1434 and describes his baptism, marriage to Jadwiga, and coronation in 1386.
